# ANGLE (Avalonia.Angle.Windows.Natives) – third-party license

`Avalonia.Angle.Windows.Natives` 2.1.27548.20260419 provides `av_libglesv2.dll` (Windows). The PDF app renders in software on Windows by default, but the library is still part of the published folder (Avalonia packages it) and is used when `RAFFICA_RENDERING=default` selects Avalonia's own GPU path. The nuspec names only a file as license (`<license type="file">`), no SPDX expression. The text is the BSD-3-Clause license of the ANGLE project; `licenses.json` therefore enters `BSD-3-Clause` by hand (the check compares nothing here).

- Source: `LICENSE` in the NuGet package (`avalonia.angle.windows.natives/2.1.27548.20260419/LICENSE`)
- SHA-256 of the original file: `54aff7276217df9f6b5181613999d208c9e40d2b1d51bf55217837e6871a4a63`
- Taken over unchanged except for LF line endings.
